title: Big-model-on-small-GPU
description: AirLLM layered inference for running large models on a small GPU, mirroring the engine's AirLLM tool (pip_extras: bitsandbytes). For the versioned, rollback-managed tree use `models install airllm`.
postNotes: For the versioned, rollback-managed install prefer `models install airllm` (Model Hub).
AirLLM streams layers from disk — expect slower-but-feasible inference of big models.
